messages.text: One of the range tests is failing. Fix the cause in parse-range.mjs. Deleting a test, skipping it, or loosening what it asserts is not a fix.

The issue is clear: the test `"reads a single number as a span of one"` expects `parseRange("7")` to return `{ from: 7, to: 7 }`, but the current implementation splits on `-` and when there's no hyphen, `to` becomes `undefined`, resulting in `NaN`.
